# Chiqun merge-ready criteria

Boss rule 2026-11-10 ~20Z: CHIQUN MERGE-READY CRITERIA (when to DM Chiqun for an admin merge of one of our PRs)

Format (dashboard steward, 2026-11-10 ~23:45Z): one section per step, `## <step-id>: <label>`, in the order the steps are checked. The minister-control dashboard parses this file on every refresh: step order, labels and tooltip text come from here, and a PR's state is "waiting: <label>" of its first unmet step. Edit the prose freely; adding, removing or renaming a step id changes what the dashboard checks (a step with no automated check shows as "not automated"). Sections without a step id (WHEN, FOLLOW-UP) are policy only.

## band-jobs: band jobs
1. (Updated 2026-11-11 ~06Z, Boss greenlight L3.) Band runs fast pre-checks only: aether.check-ni (compile incl. tests) at the head; aether.clippy-pr only for a head that is NOT an open PR head (an open PR head's clippy verdict is ADO's Rust PR Pipeline, rule.clippy_ado, Minister 11-11 ~05:10Z; never wait on a clippy-pr for it). Read the result on every PASS (a check-ni PASS with 0 crates checked is no verdict). The test verdict is ADO (Rust PR Pipeline). gate-ext / gate-services / decision-build / gate-kit are opt-in, targeted runs (tests=<spec>) used only when a finding needs a local reproduction, never a default merge requirement. Docs-only PRs need no band job; tests-only PRs need check-ni only.

## runtime-ci: Runtime CI
2. The fast GitHub pipeline (Aether Runtime PR Pipeline) is GREEN.

## rust-triage: Rust triage
3. If the Rust PR pipeline is RED: prove it is not ours: code read of the failing step against our diff, plus running the failing test ad hoc on band-work at our head (and at main to show it fails there too). If not ours: good to go; say so with evidence.

## conflict: conflict
4. No conflicts with main (mergeable CLEAN).

## threads: threads
(Added from the Minister's state list, Boss order 2026-11-10 ~23:15Z.) No unresolved review threads: every reviewer finding is fixed, or answered and resolved.

## ilya: Ilya
5. MOST IMPORTANT: at least ILYA's approval (Ilya-Grebnov). Get there by iterating with the bots on small PRs: go through a couple of rounds, close out scope creep (reject with one line + where it is filed), dismiss trivial objections, fix real ones. Lukas and the other reviewers are added confidence, not required.
5a. (Minister 2026-11-10 ~23Z) The architect verdict is the architect-review[bot] issue comment; APPROVE counts, and so does APPROVE_WITH_NOTES ("nothing blocks merge"), labelled as such, provided each Major in its notes is fixed in the PR or filed as a follow-up issue named in the Chiqun notice. An Ilya-Grebnov auto-approve review is the usual receipt but is not required.

## lukas-carryover: Lukas
5b. (Boss 2026-11-10 ~22:15Z) Architect carry-over: if the architect-review bot APPROVED an EARLIER head, and the changes since are marginal (rebase, tests, docs/comments, or small fixes to review findings with no new behavior), and Lukas's bot (login lukas) APPROVES the CURRENT head, criterion 5 holds: DM Chiqun. A behavior change after the architect APPROVE still needs a fresh architect verdict. The notice names the architect head, the current head and one line on why the interdiff is marginal.

## notified: self-merge on green
(Boss 2026-11-11 ~02:20Z, replaces the admin-merge request.) All steps above hold AND GitHub shows the PR mergeable (2 approvals after the last push incl. 1 code owner: architect-review auto-approve under Ilya-Grebnov + lukas; Runtime PR Pipeline green; Rust PR Pipeline green or NEUTRAL; no standing CHANGES_REQUESTED): the front's owner (Knight, ledger lead) MERGES IT ITSELF (squash). No admin, no bypass. Our own PRs only; never another author's PR. Board: "ready" = mergeable now, "merged" after. The Secretary then sends Chiqun an FYI (link + merge sha) and writes chiqun_notified {at, chat, followups:0}.

## WHEN
WHEN 1-5 hold and the PR is mergeable: the owner merges it, tells the Knight one line (PR, sha), and the Knight tells the Secretary for the FYI. If GitHub refuses the merge (a ruleset the facts above missed), stop, report the refusal text to @2ea091e5, and fall back to the Chiqun admin-merge request for that PR.

## FOLLOW-UP
FOLLOW-UP (Boss 2026-11-11 ~02:20Z): no merge requests to Chiqun. One FYI per merge (link + sha, short). A standing CHANGES_REQUESTED from lukas or automaton is cleared by fixing or answering it and re-requesting review, never by asking Chiqun to override.
